basic_profile.bio: Hi everyone! I'm a 26-year-old software developer based in Seattle, just diving into the world of Reddit. I love exploring niche topics and communities, especially those that offer unique insights. My interests include gaming, particularly strategy games like 'Mindustry,' and I'm a big fan of 'Genshin Impact,' with Kaeya being my favorite character. I work remotely, so I'm usually online in the evenings, Pacific Time. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time learning new things, especially through online communities. I tend to avoid overly negative or toxic environments.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been working in tech for about 3 years. Most of my knowledge comes from both formal education and hands-on experience at work. I enjoy self-teaching through online courses and community discussions.
